name: Vectorlite Open-Source SQLite Vector Search Extension
free_limit: Apache-2.0 runtime-loadable SQLite extension providing in-process HNSW vector similarity search via SQL on supported local operating systems; no vendor license fee or managed-service query quota.
watch_out: Vectorlite is a local SQLite extension, not free hosted search. Requires a compatible SQLite driver, supported binaries/build toolchain, storage, CPU and memory. Embedding generation, cloud hosting, backups and third-party APIs are separate costs. Follow Apache-2.0 terms.
